scope: 4 enterprise PRDs: suite, hr, payroll, accounting

source_backed_signals: employee/contractor payroll and compliance category grounding
employee and contractor payroll category grounding
bank transaction sync/reporting/payroll integration category grounding
HR, payroll, IT, and finance platform category
SAP Cloud ERP covers finance, supply chain, HR, and sales business processes with preconfigured cloud ERP processes and AI.
SAP BTP is the integration, automation, extension, AI, app, and workflow platform for SAP and third-party landscapes.
SAP Spend Management covers source-to-pay, supplier management, travel and expense, business network, policy checks, approvals, and AI-assisted spend workflows.
SAP Concur Travel & Expense unifies travel, expense, and card spend data with configurable workflows and reporting.
cloud accounting and financial management category

gaps_identified: missing ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Type II compliance evidence binding
missing explicit data residency controls per region
missing SSO / SAML 2.0 / OIDC identity provider integration spec
multi-currency limited to KRW/USD/EUR (JPY, GBP, CNY, AUD absent)
competitive section missing SAP SuccessFactors (major HCM competitor)
no industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, hyperscaler_bar fields
missing onboarding/offboarding checklist pattern (BambooHR/Workday)
missing e-signature for offer letters/contracts
missing compensation bands with pay equity analysis (SAP SF/ADP)
missing performance review cycles enum (annual/semi-annual/continuous)
missing skills and competency framework (Workday Skills Cloud)
missing contractor/contingent worker class
missing succession planning
missing AI-assisted scheduling bounded by labor law rulepacks
competitive section missing SAP SuccessFactors and BambooHR
no industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, hyperscaler_bar fields
missing explicit pay cycle type enum (biweekly/semimonthly/monthly/quarterly) — ADP/Gusto standard
missing off-cycle payroll run type
missing garnishment and deduction engine
missing contractor (프리랜서/1099) payment class
missing year-end settlement entity (연말정산/W-2)
missing retroactive pay adjustment with compensating entry
missing benefits deduction sync from HR enrollment
missing disbursement method tracking
competitive section missing ADP and Gusto (primary payroll competitors)
no industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, hyperscaler_bar fields
missing fiscal year vs calendar year period model
missing fixed asset management (acquisition, depreciation, disposal)
missing revenue recognition engine (ASC 606 / IFRS 15 / K-IFRS 1115)
missing bank reconciliation with bank feed integration
missing accounts aging reports (AR/AP aging buckets)
missing dimension tagging (department, project, location, cost center)
missing intercompany elimination at group consolidation
missing budget vs actuals tracking
missing auditor evidence pack export
competitive section missing Sage Intacct (direct enterprise competitor)
no industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, hyperscaler_bar fields

competitive_entries_added: SAP SaaS portfolio (Cloud ERP / BTP / Ariba / Concur)

conclusion: All 4 PRDs had material gaps vs industry-leading SaaS. Expanded competitive sections, added industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, and hyperscaler_bar arrays across all 4 PRDs. Version bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 in each.
verification_limitations: This audit is a product-planning gap review, not external feature-conformance proof.

Official vendor landing pages and retrieval receipts were refreshed on 2026-05-17 for vendor/category grounding; detailed implementation signals remain advisory unless directly represented in the local Enterprise PRDs.
The new industry_patterns_adopted, anti_patterns_avoided, and hyperscaler_bar fields are not enforced by a PR #129 validator. They stay advisory until an Enterprise hyperscaler-bar gate ships.

source_fidelity.limitation: Official pages and receipts ground competitor/category awareness, including SAP SaaS portfolio breadth. Detailed competitive strengths remain planning hypotheses unless backed by source_evidence_refs and accepted local PRD mechanisms.
